evidence: Touches src/wallet/spend.cpp, src/wallet/feebumper.cpp, src/wallet/walletdb.cpp, and wallet RPCs to add transaction creation and fee-bumping for BIP 352 destinations.
rationale: Adds major user-facing functionality by enabling the wallet to send to BIP 352 silent payment addresses. The PR description notes it provides support across send, sendtoaddress, sendmany, sendall, and validateaddress while adapting coin selection and wallet database storage for RBF recomputations.
